cases.sentence: В одиннадцатом году, в ___ месяца , было ко мне слово Господне:
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.sentence: Они сломают стены Тира и разрушат его башни, а Я вымету из Тира развалины и сделаю его ___.
cases.explain: «голой скалой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

cases.sentence: Твои стены дрогнут от топота его ___, повозок и колесниц, когда он войдет в твои ворота, как входят в город, стены которого были пробиты.
cases.explain: «боевых коней» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

cases.sentence: Он перебьет твоих жителей мечом, и твои ___ рухнут на землю.
cases.explain: «мощные колонны» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

cases.sentence: Твои стены сломают, ___ разрушат, а камни, дерево и мусор бросят в море.
cases.explain: «роскошные дома» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They will make a plunder of your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls, and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

cases.sentence: Я положу конец твоим ___, и музыка твоих арф смолкнет.
cases.explain: «шумным песням» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю тебя ___; ты станешь местом, где раскидывают рыбацкие сети.
cases.explain: «голой скалой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Я пошлю тебе ___, и тебя не станет.
cases.explain: «страшный конец» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
